name: openpalm
description: Use your personal OpenPalm agent from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Connect Claude Desktop to your local OpenPalm agent. Requests pass through OpenPalm's protected access layer, which applies the access level assigned to this key and screens untrusted input.

guardian_url.title: Local OpenPalm address
guardian_url.description: Keep the default unless OpenPalm shows a different address under Connections.

credential_key.title: OpenPalm access key
credential_key.description: Paste the key shown in OpenPalm under People & access. Its access level controls available capabilities.
